articles.title: Board of Peace delivers bleak report on Gaza, warning of ceasefire collapse without immediate action
articles.description: The Board of Peace overseeing the Gaza ceasefire between Israel and Hamas and charged with handling the reconstruction of the war-shattered Palestinian territory has delivered a bleak report on its progress to the United Nations Security Council. The report calls on all parties to live up to their commitments under the agreement. It warns that continued delays will doom the chances of restoring peace and stability to Gaza. In its conclusion, the report says, “The distance between what has been agreed and what is happening on the ground nonetheless remains the principal risk to the process.”

articles.title: Israel's genocide in Gaza continues. So must the protests
articles.description: Demonstrations gave Palestinians hope and pressured institutions to act. A ceasefire that has failed to stop the killing must not become a reason for silence
